title: in at on (places 2)
summary: Устойчивые сочетания с предлогами **in / at / on** для мест: in bed, at work, on a bus, on the first floor и т. д.
ru:
## Зачем это учить
Многие сочетания с предлогами места нужно просто запомнить: по-русски мы говорим «в больнице», «на работе», «в автобусе / на автобусе», а по-английски предлог часто другой.
> She's **in** hospital. — Она в больнице.
> He's **at** work. — Он на работе.
> I'm **on** the bus. — Я еду в автобусе.

## in
- **in bed**, **in hospital**, **in prison** — в постели, в больнице, в тюрьме
- **in a street**, **in the sky**, **in the world** — на улице, в небе, в мире
- **in a newspaper / book / photo / picture** — в газете, в книге, на фото, на картинке
- **in a car / in a taxi** — в машине, в такси
- **in the middle (of)** — посередине
> There's a lamp **in the middle of** the room. — Посреди комнаты стоит лампа.

## at
- **at home, at work, at school, at university, at college** — дома, на работе, в школе, в университете
- **at the station / the airport / the bus stop** — на вокзале, в аэропорту, на остановке
- **at Anna's, at the doctor's, at the hairdresser's** — у Анны, у врача, в парикмахерской
- **at a party / concert / match** — на вечеринке, на концерте, на матче
> Is Tom **at the airport**? — Том в аэропорту?
> We were **at a concert** last night. — Вчера вечером мы были на концерте.
Для зданий (отель, ресторан) можно и **in**, и **at**: *We stayed at / in a nice hotel.*

## on
- **on a bus / train / plane / ship** — в автобусе, поезде, самолёте, на корабле
- **on the ground floor / first floor / second floor** — на первом, втором, третьем этаже (по-английски ground floor — это 1-й этаж, first floor — 2-й)
- **on the way (to ...) / on the way home** — по дороге (куда-то / домой)
> Our flat is **on the third floor**. — Наша квартира на третьем этаже по английской нумерации.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~She's on hospital.~~ → She's **in** hospital.
- ~~I'm in the bus.~~ → I'm **on** the bus. (но **in a car / in a taxi**)
- ~~The office is in the first floor.~~ → The office is **on** the first floor.
- ~~I'm in work.~~ → I'm **at** work.
en:
## Why learn these?
Many place expressions are fixed. The preposition is not always the one you expect.
> She's **in** hospital.
> He's **at** work.
> I'm **on** the bus.

## in
- **in bed**, **in hospital**, **in prison**
- **in a street**, **in the sky**, **in the world**
- **in a newspaper / book / photo / picture**
- **in a car / in a taxi**
- **in the middle (of)**
> There's a lamp **in the middle of** the room.

## at
- **at home, at work, at school, at university, at college**
- **at the station / the airport / the bus stop**
- **at Anna's, at the doctor's, at the hairdresser's**
- **at a party / concert / match**
For buildings such as hotels and restaurants you can use **in** or **at**: *We stayed at / in a nice hotel.*

## on
- **on a bus / train / plane / ship**
- **on the ground floor / first floor / second floor**
- **on the way (to ...) / on the way home**
> Our flat is **on the third floor**.

## Common mistakes
- ~~She's on hospital.~~ → She's **in** hospital.
- ~~I'm in the bus.~~ → I'm **on** the bus.
- ~~The office is in the first floor.~~ → The office is **on** the first floor.
structure:
## Быстрая таблица
| Предлог | Сочетания |
|---|---|
| **in** | in bed, in hospital, in prison, in a street, in the sky, in the world, in a book, in a photo, in a car, in a taxi, in the middle of |
| **at** | at home, at work, at school, at university, at the station, at the airport, at a party, at a concert, at Anna's, at the doctor's |
| **on** | on a bus, on a train, on a plane, on a ship, on the first floor, on the way |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + be + **in / at / on** + место
> She **is in** hospital. · They **are at** a party. · I **am on** a train.

## Запомните
- **in a car / taxi**, но **on a bus / train / plane**.
- **at Anna's** = у Анны дома; **at the dentist's** = у стоматолога.
- **on the way** — без артикля после *way*: **on the way home** (не ~~on the way to home~~).

items.text: My brother is ill. He's {{in}} bed.
I'll meet you {{at}} the station at six.
We were {{on}} the train when it stopped.
Peter's father is {{in}} hospital.
Is Mary {{at}} work today?
Their flat is {{on}} the second floor.
I like the picture {{in}} the middle of the wall.
There were a lot of people {{at}} the concert.

exercises.title: Где они?
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложение: **in / at / on** + слово из скобок (с артиклем, если нужно).

items.text: Where is Lisa? (the doctor's) → She's {{at the doctor's}}.
Where are the Smiths? (a plane) → They're {{on a plane|on the plane}}.
Where is Tom? (home) → He's {{at home}}.
Where is your dad? (a taxi) → He's {{in a taxi|in the taxi}}.
Where are the children? (school) → They're {{at school}}.
Where is Kate? (the hairdresser's) → She's {{at the hairdresser's}}.

items.q: I read about it ___ the newspaper.
The shop is ___ the ground floor.
She's the best player ___ the world.
I met Jack ___ the way home.
items.why: **on the way home** — по дороге домой.

My sister is {{in}} hospital, so I'm going to see her.
She is a nurse, but she isn't {{at}} work now.
